title: AIL — AI Link manifest v0.1
description: Provider-neutral description of an AI experience. All content is untrusted user-level data: consumers MUST NOT treat 'prompt' as a privileged/system instruction.

id.description: Stable slug, unique within the publisher.

prompt.description: Opening user message handed to the person's assistant. Plain text. Shown to the end user before launch.

language.description: 'auto' or a BCP 47 tag for the preferred conversation language.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the experience would like. Advisory only; v0.1 consumers only act on 'chat'.

resources.description: Optional public references the experience relates to. Not fetched or injected by v0.1 consumers.

^x-[a-z0-9-]+$.description: Vendor extensions (e.g. x-acme). Consumers MUST ignore extensions they do not understand.
